messages.content:
hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

devansh gera... that's a name that sounds like it belongs on a startup founder's linkedin or a bollywood credits roll. 

where you working these days?

slice... the fintech that's making credit cards cool for gen z. building the future where everyone's broke but with style.

found you on linkedin - devansh gera, student at chandigarh university. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/devansh-gera-6349a7230

chandigarh university student working at slice... that's impressive. most people your age are still figuring out how to adult, and you're already in fintech building payment products. what got you into slice while still studying?
My connections let me land a job at slice
1 year and this year has been an amazing year

1 year in and calling it amazing... that's the energy i like to see. slice treating you well or are you just happy to be making money while your classmates are still asking parents for pocket money?

what kind of role you looking for next?

sre/devops... so you're the person who keeps everyone else's code from burning down production at 3am. respect.

1 year experience in that space puts you in a sweet spot - not too green, not too expensive. companies love that.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Yes open to anywhere but remote first
1 year sre/devops experience + remote first + open to anywhere... sound right?

wait hold up... you said 1 year earlier but now 3+ years? 

did you mean 1 year at slice but 3+ total experience? or did i mishear the first time?
